name: micropython-debug-bridge
description: Direct MCP access to connected MicroPython serial devices

interface.shortDescription: Control a MicroPython MCU over its host serial device.
interface.longDescription: Lists and selects macOS /dev/cu.* devices, installs MicroPython files, monitors serial output, resets the MCU, and exposes structured runtime debugging through a local stdio MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the connected MicroPython serial devices and help me select one.
